newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Three Arab youths die in West Bank blast - officials.
newsitem.headline: Three Arab youths die in West Bank blast - officials.

text.p: An explosion killed at least three Palestinian youths in a West Bank village on Thursday, PLO security officials said.

The cause of the blast in the village of Anza was not immediately clear. Israel maintains overall security control of the area under its peace deals with the PLO but Palestinian police also are deployed there.

The explosion tore off the heads of two of the three dead, the security officials said, adding that the Israeli army had taken away two bodies. The third body was taken to a hospital in the nearby self-ruled town of Jenin, a doctor said.
The officials said the dead were aged between 15 and 17.
An Israeli military source confirmed there was an explosion and said Israeli forces had been sent to the village to investigate.
On Saturday, an Islamic militant, possibly preparing for a suicide attack against Israel, was killed in the same area of the West Bank when a bomb exploded in his hands.

Israeli security forces have been on high alert for weeks, fearing attempts by the Islamic Jihad guerrilla group to avenge the killing of its leader Fathi Shqaqi in Malta on October 26, 1995. Palestinians believe Israel carried out the assassination.
